response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans) AS fraction FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
